title: ReauthorizationRequest
description: Worker stopped because a redirect or newly discovered target requires a new Core evaluation. This message does not grant authorization, widen scope, or change budget.

worker_id.description: Opaque Worker runtime identity. Not a Core principal.

current_target_reference.description: Opaque reference to the target under the current Core decision.

proposed_target_reference.description: Opaque newly observed/redirected target. Not automatically in scope.

reason.description: Why execution stopped (redirect, new hostname, discovered asset, etc.). Not an allow decision.

discovery_context.description: Untrusted discovery detail. MUST NOT be treated as authorization, Evidence, or Finding.
